response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly. That is why it will be so revolutionary. We will take the best of our current aesthetic and... and... (he snaps his fingers)...we will vaporwave it.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the finest, most ornate clothing. But as they begin to discuss the king's vision, we notice that their attire is adorned with strange, futuristic accessories - neon-colored sashes, holographic brooches, and gleaming metallic accents.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We will take the grandeur of our castles, the opulence of our palaces, and the mystique of our knights. And we will... we will... (he winks)...we will make it all... retro-futuristic.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The king's vision is taking shape. The castle walls are now adorned with glowing, neon-colored tapestries, and the moat is filled with a swirling, iridescent mist. The knights, now dressed in shimmering, metallic armor, ride by on hoverbikes, their helmets emblazoned with holographic logos.

KING
(to his courtiers)
And what of our enemies, my friends? How will we... (he chuckles)...how will we vaporwave them?

CUT TO:

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY

The king's army, now dressed in their futuristic attire, faces off against a rival kingdom. But instead of traditional armor and swords, the rival kingdom's warriors are dressed in tattered, distressed clothing, with ripped and frayed edges.

KING
(to his army)
Charge! (he shouts) Show them the power of... of... (he grins)...of vaporwave!

The battle rages on, with the king's army using their futuristic gear to devastating effect. But as the fight wears on, we notice that the rival kingdom's warriors are beginning to... (he chuckles)...begin to glitch.

CUT TO:

EXT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king sits on his throne, surrounded by his courtiers, who are all dressed in their finest, most ornate clothing. But as they begin to discuss the king's latest conquest, we notice that they are all using... (he smiles)...they are all using the latest in futuristic slang.

KING
(to his courtiers)
I have a new plan, my friends. A plan to... to... (he winks)...to make our empire the most... the most... (he chuckles)...the most vaporwave in all the land.

COURTIER 1 (he)
I'm down, Your Majesty. I'm totally here for it.

COURTIER 2 (she)
Me too, Your Majesty. I'm all about that vaporwave life.

KING
(smiling)
Excellent. Then let us... (he snaps his fingers)...let us make it happen.

FADE TO BLACK.
